scripts.pretest:php:lint: npm run test:php:start && npm run test-composer -- install --no-interaction
scripts.test:php:lint: wp-env run wordpress --config=.wp-env.tests.json --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wp-profile-box composer run-script lint
scripts.test:lint:php: npm run test:php:lint || (test_status=$?; npm run test:php:stop; exit $test_status)
scripts.pretest:php:unit: npm run test:php:start && npm run test-composer -- install --no-interaction
scripts.test:unit:php: npm run test:php:unit || (test_status=$?; npm run test:php:stop; exit $test_status)
scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:unit
